entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, thanks for calling VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hello David. I'm calling about returning a helmet I bought a couple of months ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Yes, the name is Alex Chen, and the order number is VF886-12-05.

Thank you, Alex. I'm pulling that up now... I see the order for the Trail Helmet, delivered on December 5th. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a preference thing. My partner bought it, and the color just isn't for me. We've been so busy, it's just been sitting in the closet. The box is still unopened and everything.

I understand completely. Let me just review our return policy for you one moment... Okay, I have good news. Our policy allows for returns up to 10 days after delivery, so you're unfortunately outside the window to send it back for a full refund.

Oh, that's excellent. I appreciate you approving that. Since I'll be ordering a replacement, is there any possibility of getting a small discount code for my next purchase? Just to make the process a little smoother.

I'm glad we could get this sorted out for you. While I can't provide a discount for a preference-based return, I can process this for a full refund to your original payment method immediately. Our main priority is your safety, and we want to ensure you have a helmet you're happy to wear on every ride.
Okay, that's fair. A full refund is what matters most. So, you'll send a return label?

That's correct. I've just emailed a prepaid return label to you. Just attach that to the box and drop it off at any shipping center. Once we receive the unopened helmet, you'll see the refund in 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help, David.
You're very welcome, Alex. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
